title: Cloud City: Testing for Reliability: Load, Chaos & Game Days
city_concept: City Fire Drills & Controlled Seismic Testing

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: The city built a massive new suspension bridge, but nobody knew if it could withstand gale-force winds until a winter storm nearly collapsed it.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: Chief Inspector Ines established mandatory wind-tunnel testing and controlled seismic vibration drills before certifying public structures.

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: During a simulated gas explosion drill, emergency dispatchers noticed a hospital route was blocked by construction and established a permanent bypass.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: Physical city destructive testing damages concrete; cloud chaos experiments inject non-destructive, scoped digital faults.
